title: feat: add Grok TTS
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `grok-tts` as a new paid-only audio model on `/audio/{text}` and `POST /v1/audio/speech`.
- Routes directly to xAI `POST /v1/tts` with no aliases, fallback, or Pollinations GPU.
- Exposes all 28 built-in xAI voices with MP3, WAV, and PCM output; the existing `alloy` default maps to Eve.
- Bills deterministic Unicode input characters at xAI’s $15/M rate with `priceMultiplier: 1`.
- Keeps custom voices, streaming TTS, and additional codecs out of scope.

Validation:
- Authenticated voice discovery returned 28 voices; all 28 × 3 formats passed direct (84/84, 399 ms average, 834 ms maximum).
- Provider billing reconciliation used a 200-code-point input (300 UTF-16 units, 700 UTF-8 bytes). xAI Usage Explorer increased by exactly 200 input characters and one request (2,280→2,480; 138→139), confirming the implementation’s code-point metering.
- Local Gen E2E passed both public routes with canonical model, voice, format, and usage headers.
- After merging current `main`: 94 provider tests, 69 catalog/permission tests, 83 Enter billing tests, typecheck, and Biome passed.

Addresses #11027

gist.headline: The hive found a voice
gist.blurb: Grok TTS has joined the audio garden. Pick from 28 xAI voices and turn text into MP3, WAV, or PCM without teaching a bee to operate a microphone.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `grok-tts` to `/audio/{text}` and `POST /v1/audio/speech`, routing directly to xAI TTS with 28 built-in voices, MP3/WAV/PCM output, and Unicode code-point billing at xAI’s $15 per million characters.
gist.impact: Developers can now use `grok-tts` with the existing `alloy` default mapped to Eve, choose any of 28 xAI voices, and receive consistent usage metering across both public audio endpoints.
